From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Susan — thanks for the note. Attached is the network diagram (permacare-network-diagram-v2.pdf) and a short gate checklist below. I kept it focused for your network team so they can confirm quickly. If anything looks like it needs more detail, flag it and we’ll add a specific ticket.

Key pre-kickoff gate checklist (network & security):
- CIDR allocation confirmed (no overlap w/ Redwood service plane): 10.40.0.0/16 (customer), 10.41.0.0/16 (staging) — confirm
- Core firewall egress/ingress rules: allow outbound HTTPS to Redwood control plane IP range + inbound health checks from our ops CIDR (provided in diagram)
- Private peering / Transit: BGP peering with customer transit (ASN 64521) or VPC peering as backup; list expected ASN/peer IPs
- KMS access pattern: customer-managed KMS key (required), cross-account/role used by Redwood service identity; provide IAM role ARN and key policy entry
- Ports/Protocols: TCP 443 for control plane; TCP 10250 for optional agent health checks (toggleable)
- Audit logging & retention: forward audit logs to customer SIEM; retention 365 days (confirm longer if required)
- DNS resolution: private zone delegation or conditional forwarding (we support both)
- Maintenance window: preferred Jul 13-15 PT; please confirm a 3-hour window per region

Attachments: permacare-network-diagram-v2.pdf (diagram), rdw-kms-policy-diff.txt (summary of required KMS policy change)

Proposed next step: 30-min validation call with your network lead + our infra engineer (Dev Patel) to walk the diagram and pin the maintenance window. We can run a short smoke plan during the window and rollback quickly if needed.

If Jul 13 works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include Dev, Neha (security), and Marissa (onboarding lead).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
